remarks: Welcome to Unit 816 at 60 Strawberry Hill Avenue - a bright and spacious 1-bedroom condo in Stamford's desirable Royal Pavilion. This updated unit features an open layout, a modern kitchen with quartz counters, and a comfortable living area with city views. The well-maintained building offers 24-hour security, a fitness room, sauna, convenient on-site laundry facilities, and garage parking, with most utilities (heat, hot water, water, AC)included in the HOA. Perfect for both owners and investors, this is an investor-friendly building with comparable units renting for approximately $1,750 per month. Conveniently located near downtown shops, dining, and transportation, this condo offers easy, worry-free living in the heart of Stamford.
